How we work

Four phases. Full visibility.

Deliverables at every phase. You decide what’s next.

Phase 01 · Week 1

Audit

We interview your users, map the systems and data in play, and write the scope down.

Phase 02 · Weeks 2–3

Prototype

A clickable first release, the architecture proposal, and hours costed per feature.

Phase 03 · Weeks 4–12

Build

A release every two weeks, with a weekly report on progress, risk and hours left.

Phase 04 · After launch

Handover

Documentation, monitoring and on-call handed to your team, or kept with ours.

FAQ

Questions we get on the first call

How do you price a project?

Discovery is a fixed fee. After that you choose a fixed-scope phase price or a monthly team rate. Both come with an hour ledger you can read at any time.

Who owns the code?

You do, from the first commit. Repositories sit in your organisation and we work inside them.

We have no in-house developers. Does that work?

Most of our clients are in that position. We handle the technical decisions and translate them into plain trade-offs for you to approve.

Can you take over an existing codebase?

Yes. We start with a two-week audit covering dependencies, tests and access, then give you a remediation plan before touching features.

What happens if we want to stop?

Contracts end at the close of any phase with 30 days notice. Handover documentation is part of every phase, not an extra.
